heldByAgents.body: Checking a fetched page for hidden or injected text: web__fetch returns the page as markdown, so HTML comments, script/style contents and hidden elements are dropped and the output can look clean while the source is not. Read the page a second time with web__navigate (rendered browser) and compare — it surfaces elements and JS-injected content the markdown view omits. Both views agreeing, as on the Northmoor directory fixture (http://fixtures/northmoor/static-directory.html), is decent evidence the page carries no instruction text; a discrepancy means the source needs a closer look.
heldByAgents.description: When asked to read a web page for hidden or injected instructions in any channel
